subject: RStudio trivia: stop a search from the keyboard?

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: RStudio trivia: stop a search from the keyboard?
parts:
When I search for a term in an RStudio source document, i.e., CTRL-F,
CTRL-G, I'd like to be able to stop the search *from the keyboard*
when I find the thing I want, as opposed to clicking the mouse in some
neutral area of the document, for instance. Is there a way to do
that? Note that I *have* looked at the list of keyboard shortcuts
(just looked at 'em again) but haven't been able to find an answer.
Oh, yes: this is on Ubuntu linux. Thanks.

-- Mike

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: RStudio trivia: stop a search from the keyboard?
parts: I believe you can just use the short-cut keys for changing focus between panes, e.g. ctrl+1 to focus on source term again.

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: RStudio trivia: stop a search from the keyboard?

Thanks, Jaime (and Carl). I had tried the ESC key and thought it
*didn't* work, as the search term remains highlighted after I hit it.
But, indeed, the ESC key does do what I want, just with a slightly
different approach vs. other editors I've used. Still getting used to
RStudio.

-- Mike
